conviction_note: The findings net to -0.75 (an upstream tailwind that sits inside the guide, set against a competitor taking share in perforating, Halliburton's softer US Land print and Middle East freight risk). None of them is a company-level number the market has not seen, so p_up stays at 50 and the scaled number is 0. abs_move_pct stays at the implied 19% because the Arcadia put has been exercisable since 2026-09-06 and has not been disclosed either way, and its status will almost certainly be addressed in this release or on the call. The two measurements disagree in size only because the put is a variance item with no sign.

positioning_check: Short interest 171,829 shares (prior month 202,385), 0.95% of float, days to cover 1.71 (https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/boom/statistics/, page dated 2026-10-27, settlement date not shown). Not a crowded short and falling. Skew: skew_25d_vol_points is null in the baseline. findings.finding: The US completions backdrop improved in Q3 2026: the Primary Vision frac spread count averaged about 191.5 in Q3 against about 181.8 in Q2 (+5.4% q/q, roughly +12% y/y). Liberty Energy (2026-10-21) said 'modestly higher completions activity has absorbed much of the industry's available capacity', with 'continued improvement in service pricing' and Q4 seasonality 'partially offset by continued strength in demand'. This supports DynaEnergetics, about 43% of Q2 sales, delivering the sequential increase in the Q3 guide and giving a firmer Q4 tone. The guide had already assumed 'increases in well completion activity', so most of this sits inside it.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Q2 print (2026-07-29) traded +15.5% on revenue at the top of its range with Dyna +13% q/q, then drifted -23%. Q1 2026 (Dyna -9% y/y) and the Q4 2025 print (2026-02-23) traded -33%. The stock has moved hard on the energy line both ways.
findings.why_not_priced: The guide assumes higher completions but gives no Dyna dollar figure. If the market had priced a firm Q3/Q4 energy tone, the stock would not have drifted 23% since the last print to within 14% of its 52-week low. Q4 outlook commentary is new information at this release.
findings.independence: Liberty Energy Q3 2026 release: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001694028/000169402826000055/q32026-earningsrelease.htm (2026-10-21), a different source. Contradicted in part by Halliburton (finding 3).

findings.finding: Competitive pressure in North American perforating is building against DynaEnergetics. On 2026-09-23, after DMC last spoke, Hunting said Hunting Titan was ranked the No.1 preferred supplier for the second year running (Kimberlite) and pointed to 'growing preference for Hunting Titan's shaped charges and perforating guns in the North American land market'. Hunting's H1 update had already reported Perforating Systems 'significantly ahead of expectations' on North American share gains. On the Q2 call DMC's CEO said 'Pricing is still hard to come by... no price increases, and it's very competitive'. The Q2 Dyna margin of 8.4% (13.4% a year earlier) included a $1.5M tariff refund that is not in the Q3 guide.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Prints with Dyna margin compression (2025-08-05 at -18.8%, 2025-11-04 at -18.6%) traded heavily down.
findings.why_not_priced: DMC told the market pricing was tough, so part of this is known. The Sept 23 share-preference data came after DMC last spoke. If the market expected Dyna share loss, consensus revenue ($161.1M) would sit below the guide midpoint by more than $2M. Net of the rest: Arcadia is guided 'steady' and NobelClad up, so a Dyna miss of a few million can still be absorbed in revenue, which is why this is sized small.
findings.independence: DMC Q2 call (CEO on pricing), https://www.webull.com/news/15364520756012032 (2026-07-29), a different document from Hunting's.

findings.finding: Halliburton's Q3 2026 North America revenue was $2.2B, -5% sequentially, 'primarily driven by lower pressure pumping services in U.S. Land' (reported 2026-10-20). Its early-2027 view assumes a flat North America market with no frac recovery. Read through to perforating-gun demand, this cuts against finding 1. It is one company's share and fleet decisions, and the frac count and Liberty point the other way.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: As for finding 1: the energy line has moved this stock 15-33% at prints.
findings.why_not_priced: It is a large-cap print, already public for a week. A read-through to a $110M microcap is rarely made explicitly. Sized small as a proxy that a broader series (frac count) partly contradicts.

findings.finding: The Arcadia minority holder's put on the remaining 40% has been exercisable since 2026-09-06, at a floor value of $187.1M against DMC's market cap of about $110M. DMC can settle in cash, or 20% cash and 80% preferred stock (3% dividend, convertible 1:1, conversion and voting capped at 19.9%, proportionate annual redemptions from 2027-06-23). On the Q2 call the CEO said 'we have absolutely no idea if our partner will stay in the joint venture'. EDGAR shows no 8-K from DMC since the 2026-07-29 print (latest filing a 13G on 2026-08-14), so whether it has been exercised is undisclosed. The Q3 release, 10-Q subsequent-events note or call will very likely address it. The sign is unknowable; this is the largest variance item on the name.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior print resolved the put. The December 2024 deferral to September 2026 was described by the CEO as 'immediate and significant relief from the potential equity dilution'.
findings.why_not_priced: The overhang is public and is a plausible reason for the -23% drift, so the bad case is partly in the price. What the market does not know is the state after Sept 6. That is why this widens abs_move_pct and adds nothing to the sum.
findings.independence: Q2 call transcript, https://www.webull.com/news/15364520756012032 (2026-07-29). EDGAR filing list (no 8-K after 2026-07-29): https://www.sec.gov/cgi-bin/browse-edgar?action=getcompany&CIK=0000034067&type=&dateb=&owner=include&count=40

findings.finding: Arcadia's closest listed peer had a steady quarter. Apogee's fiscal Q2 2027 (quarter ended 2026-08-29, overlapping DMC's Q3) showed Architectural Metals sales of $143.5M, +1.8% y/y, gross margin +150bp and a raised full-year EPS guide. That is consistent with DMC's 'steady performance at Arcadia' guide despite DMC's CEO calling commercial construction 'still horrible'.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 Arcadia (+9% y/y, 13.6% margin) coincided with a +15.5% reaction. Q1 2026 Arcadia (-14% y/y) preceded the weak tape.
findings.why_not_priced: Apogee's print came after DMC last spoke. A peer read-through is a proxy, and the result sits inside DMC's 'steady' guide, hence small.
findings.independence: Secondary summary of the Apogee release. https://grafa.com/en/news/united-states/apogee-enterprises-reports-q2-fiscal-2027-results shares the same underlying document.

findings.finding: The US Midwest aluminium premium stayed elevated through 2026 (H1 average about 109 c/lb). DMC said higher aluminium prices lifted Arcadia sales and listed 'continued volatility in aluminum input costs' as outside the guide. This should help reported revenue against the $161.1M consensus, with an unknown margin effect. Net zero for the stock.
findings.why_not_priced: Price pass-through lifts the top line, and that is what the print_vs_bar_pct of +1.0 reflects. A revenue beat made of pass-through is low quality, so the stock effect is 0.
findings.independence: DMC Q2 call on aluminium price effects, https://www.webull.com/news/15364520756012032

findings.finding: Middle East hostilities escalated through the quarter (WTI averaged about $87 in Q3and about $100 into 2026-10-20, per Liberty's 10-Q as summarised). DMC's Q3 guide explicitly 'does not contemplate increased disruptions in international supply chains', and on the Q2 call the CEO cited freight problems at its European operations causing 'timing issues'. This is a risk to Dyna's international and NobelClad shipment timing. Higher oil is a Q4 demand positive, already counted in finding 1.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: NobelClad timing has hit prior quarters: Q2 sales were -17% y/y and backlog fell to $63.5M from $70.3M.
findings.why_not_priced: Macro-to-company transmission that the company has not confirmed; filed as a small proxy.

findings.finding: Positioning is light. Short interest is 0.95% of float with 1.7 days to cover and falling. The stock has given back 23% since a +15.5% reaction to the Q2 print and sits 14% above its 52-week low at about 0.6x the Arcadia NCI floor. There is no squeeze fuel, and no crowded long to unwind.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 4 of 7 prior reactions up. The median absolute move is 18.6%.
findings.why_not_priced: Positioning is the information set itself, not something it misses. A drawdown with a plausible public cause (the put overhang) is worth 0 per lesson 5.

findings.finding: DMC pulled its Q3 release forward to 2026-10-27, from 2025-11-04 for the same quarter last year (announced 2026-10-14). Reporting earlier than usual is weakly associated with good news.
findings.why_not_priced: Statistical proxy only, and the date is on the wire. Sized at the noise level.

outside_window.finding: Redemption of any Put Preferred issued in a put settlement would begin on 2027-06-23, and a stockholder vote on lifting the 19.9% cap could hand the minority holder majority voting control. These are long-dated consequences of the put that the trade will not see.

baseline_tension: The baseline gives no skew, and the 20-day run-up is a mild -4.6% after a -23% post-print drift. My net-slightly-negative operating findings agree with that weak tape, which is why they move p_up nowhere. The undisclosed put status agrees with the 19% implied move being large rather than small.
lessons_applied: Lesson 6 (inside the guide): the upstream-tailwind finding sits inside a guide that already assumed higher completions, cut from +1.5 to +1.0.

Lesson 9 (net of the rest): Dyna competition finding sized net of Arcadia 'steady' and NobelClad up, cut from -1.5 to -1.0. Halliburton read-through cut from -0.75 to -0.5 as a proxy partly contradicted by the broader frac count (lesson 5).

Lesson 5: Middle East macro transmission cut from -1.0 to -0.75. Apogee peer proxy cut from +0.5 to +0.3. Positioning/drawdown finding set from +0.5 to 0, because the drawdown has a plausible public cause and positioning is the information set.

Lesson 4 (financing is a question): the Arcadia put kept at 0 with a wide band. It is a settlement obligation, not funding for growth, but whether it was exercised is unknown, so it moves abs_move_pct and not the sign.
Lessons 6/7: the bar is the company guide, with one street source noted. Short interest checked before the negatives (0.95% of float, not crowded).
